concerns.text: Task T001 is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it creates the project skeleton and files that later tasks depend on; running it in parallel with any other task could cause race conditions. `[P]` should be removed or the task should be declared a foundational, non‑parallel task.

Task T003 consumes the unified raw data produced by T002 (downloaded files) but the plan lists T002 and T003 as parallel after T001. This creates a consumer‑before‑producer ordering violation; T003 must run after T002 completes.

Tasks T008, T009, and T010 are scheduled to run in parallel after T006, yet T009 (figure generation) may require the feature‑importance artifact generated by T007, which is still pending. US‑3 tasks should be sequenced after all US‑2 tasks (including T007) to guarantee required inputs exist.

Task T011 (README authoring) depends on the PNG figures produced by T009 and on the JSON metrics from T008/T010. The plan notes it can start after T009, but does not enforce that T008 and T010 have also completed, risking missing references. The ordering should explicitly require T008, T009, and T010 to finish before T011.
